fieldNotes.location: Address 2911 Nevada Blvd, Charlotte NC 28273 confirmed via Hub.biz/Yellowpages/PotatoPro. Plant positively identified by the red Frito-Lay logo on the building wall in Street View. Locked center 35.115626,-80.941746.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Continuous chain-link perimeter fence runs along Nevada Blvd; the truck driveway pierces the fence at a controlled gated opening. Visible in Street View (Oct 2025) and z20 satellite.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small white booth structure sits just inside the fenced truck entrance off Nevada Blvd, confirmed in multiple Street View headings and z20 satellite — staffed guard shack at the gate.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved approach from the Nevada Blvd gate into the truck yard; holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Trailers backed against the building west/southwest face; ~35 doors estimated but smoke/equipment clutter obscures an exact count — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two large drop-trailer fields — long angled rows along the northwest woods edge and a southern lot — well over 50 trailers parked.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Single dominant dock bank on the building west face; could not confirm a physically separate ship/receive cluster — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: An office building and a conveyor-bridged warehouse across Nevada Blvd are associated, but the plant proper is one building cluster; buildingCount 2 counts the plant office.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the Charlotte metro industrial fabric (Steele Creek / I-485 corridor); Urban.
fieldNotes.yardMetrics: Honest overhead estimates; ~35 dock doors, ~80 trailers visible across drop yards and docks, ~42 acres from perimeter box.
